title: The Merciful Maria
subtitle: Always keep things nice and tidy.

items.text: The Merciful Maria

items.speaker: Tennant
items.text: What a beautiful view.

items.speaker: Tennant
items.text: I'll miss the fields and villages outside Paris, but a journey like this comes with its own thrills.

items.speaker: Tennant
items.text: And what does my dear, lustrous beauty think of it?
Eternity is still appreciating her newest addition—"The Merciful Maria."
Rare, dazzling, gaudy in its power, priceless in appearance, and acquired at nearly no cost.

items.speaker: Eternity
items.text: Don't expect too much of me for now, "Brette." A trip like this always leaves me sore and tired; I'm in no mood for it anymore.

items.speaker: Tennant
items.text: Have you taken a liking to that name? Shall I go by Madame Cosette a little longer for you?

items.speaker: Eternity
items.text: You know how I crave novelty, Ada—like that "Bloody Sunset" you treated me to.

items.speaker: Tennant
items.text: If it left you longing, we can plan another night out for drinks. But then, surely you knew it was only a raspberry cocktail?

items.speaker: Eternity
items.text: A lovely way to signal our little conspiracy. Memorable—fun even, wasn't it?

items.speaker: Eternity
items.text: Neither of us imagined we'd cross paths at that party with the same goal in mind.

items.speaker: Tennant
items.text: —But just look at the surprise we crafted together.

items.speaker: Eternity
items.text: This was truly an unbelievable gift, Ada.

items.speaker: Tennant
items.text: All I really paid was a few lies and some diamonds destined to turn back into charcoal. Truly you ought to be thanking our dear Mr. Longen.

items.speaker: Tennant
items.text: I'd call that a happy ending.

items.speaker: Eternity
items.text: Oh, don't forget one more small cost—my "Box from the South" stuffed with diamonds.

items.speaker: Tennant
items.text: Of course. A clever box and a handful of sparkling stones—perfect bait for that first taste of trust.

items.speaker: Tennant
items.text: And smashing the box—that was thrilling, unforgettable. I'll cherish this little performance of ours forever.

items.speaker: Eternity
items.text: It was a true stroke of brilliance to bring in that detective. Every single angle accounted for.

items.speaker: Eternity
items.text: That clipping may have exposed "Brette," but it let Tennant twist Fleming into believing an even deeper story.

items.speaker: Eternity
items.text: Though it does make me wonder—what became of the real Brette?
At last, Tennant shares her secret candy.

items.speaker: Tennant
items.text: The real Madame Cosette is still abroad, recovering from gastritis. She won't be returning to France for a long time.

items.speaker: Eternity
items.text: It was a risk, taking on a real name like that.

items.speaker: Tennant
items.text: I knew Fleming wouldn't argue the point.

items.speaker: Tennant
items.text: He still thinks we're building that factory.
Their laughter is carried on the wind down the French country road.

items.speaker: Eternity
items.text: You know what we're missing?

items.speaker: Eternity
items.text: Some sound techs, a camera perhaps, and a crew to cheer—"Heist successful!" Something we might broadcast to the world.

items.speaker: Eternity
items.text: You've won me over, Ada. Have you thought of our next move?

items.speaker: Tennant
items.text: If you'll join me, we can lay low together for a while.

items.speaker: Tennant
items.text: I know someone with a very special suitcase ...
